//: jscpd (copy/paste detector) - WEB baseline. Mechanically enforces DRY ('duplicated logic that drifts is a defect'). EDIT the path/ignore globs to your layout.
//min: Detection floor tuned to flag real shared logic, not trivial boilerplate. 8 lines / 70 tokens is jscpd's sensible mid-range: below it you catch import blocks and JSX scaffolding (noise); above it you miss genuinely duplicated helpers.
//threshold: BASELINE-THEN-RATCHET. Set at or JUST ABOVE the current REAL duplication %% so hygiene can only improve, never regress. NOT zero (that fails immediately on any existing code). On a FRESH repo the real baseline is ~0, so 0.5 is a fine start; on an existing repo run `npx jscpd` once, read the reported %%, and set this just above it. Ratchet DOWN as clones are extracted.
